versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Competitor Win/Loss Analysis Specialist skill.
- Automates extraction of competitive intelligence and insights from CRM, customer churn, and survey data.
- Generates actionable outputs like competitive battle cards, objection patterns, weak spot profiles, and messaging frameworks.
- Integrates with major platforms including HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Sheets, Intercom, Zendesk, and survey tools.
- Supports automated reporting, Slack alerts, and exports for sales enablement platforms.
- Designed for easy weekly use to provide up-to-date competitive insights to go-to-market teams.
